changes: Critical fix: @mention detection was built only from people who'd already posted a message in the current chat history — meaning nobody could be mentioned at all in a fresh or just-cleared chat (like right after using the new Clear Chat button), or before that person had said anything. Now built from the full roster (Board + Tipping-only) instead, same source the Casino leaderboard already uses.

Diagnostics now also checks whether send-mention.mjs and send-group-notify.mjs are actually deployed — same deployment-verification pattern already used for send-nudge.mjs, extended to the two newer push functions.
